title: SM room-policy hygiene: stop megafiles + tip-extension slop
description:
Code-quality epic from the SM room-policy / tip-extension review (2026-08-06).

**Problem:** Tip wiring (TipSegment → SpineHop → catalog) is healthy. Room-controller growth is not. Wave landed as a 1345-line multi-room megafile (with a real `_DOOR_X` silent regression). early_spine grew 659→1546 with Ceres reactive state machines. Spazer package already shows the correct layout; Wave ignored it.

**Goals:**
1. Decompose Wave + Ceres before Ice pure invents more spaghetti in the same files.
2. Canonicalize human RLE / play_script / knockback helpers so new rooms reuse one path.
3. Second-pass consolidate green room policies without changing knobs.
4. Codify prevention checklist in PROCESS so agents stop re-learning from Wave's bad shape.

**Non-goals:** STATUS promote, new route knobs, Ice pure implementation (rr-dbu.11).

**Exit:** Pass A (Wave package + Ceres extract + RLE canon + helper cleanup) green dual pure/continuous; Pass B residuals purged; PROCESS checklist landed; Ice pure starts on empty ground.
design:
Three waves (behavior-preserving unless noted):

**Pass A — stop bleeding (before Ice pure)**
- Package Wave (spazer-like)
- Extract Ceres from early_spine
- Promote play_script; load data/*.json RLE
- One escape_kb; delete soft-budget pass

**Pass B — second pass existing policies**
- Thin Wave/Spazer/to_speed/speed_return/cathedral using shared primitives
- Split guide_paths by arc
- Residual doc lifecycle purge

**Pass C — prevention**
- PROCESS.md room-policy layout checklist
- House rule: multi-hop tip → package from day 1; no bare `_DOOR_X` in multi-hop modules
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] No multi-hop room policy file over 1k lines (Wave packaged; early_spine slim)
- [ ] Product RLE loads from routes/kpdr/data/*.json (no inlined Wave gate tuple)
- [ ] play_script lives in controller_common (or routes/rle) and is used by Wave + Spazer
- [ ] PROCESS.md has Room policy layout + prevention checklist
- [ ] Residuals only for open tip segments (green-hop residuals deleted)
- [ ] Dual pure Wave stack + continuous --to wave still green (no intentional knob change)

title: Pass A: package k4_wave into routes/kpdr/wave/ (1345→split)
description:
## Severity
**P0 structural.** k4_wave.py is a brand-new 0→1345 line megafile holding three independent room policies. Already caused a silent continuous/pure regression.

## Incident evidence
Commit `9f5b2c6` (rr-dbu.1): K4.9/K4.10 added Double Chamber `_DOOR_X = 920`, which **overwrote** Bubble sill `_DOOR_X = 470` at import time so blue-door push never shot. Fix was prefix rename (`_BSC_DOOR_*` / `_DC_DOOR_*`) — a bandage, not a design.

## Current structure (one file)
| Segment | Role | Approx lines |
|---------|------|--------------|
| Bubble → Single | blue door | ~45–308 |
| Single → Double | missile red door | ~310–575 |
| Double → Wave | gate RLE + Super door + PLM | ~577–1345 |

Also: three near-identical `_escape_kb` / `_escape_kb_sc` / `_escape_kb_dc` (only `stop_room_id` differs); soft-budget `pass` dead code ×3; inlined `_HUMAN_GATE_OPEN_RLE` despite `data/double_chamber_gate_open_rle.json`.

## Why this blocks tip extension
Ice pure (rr-dbu.11) and Moat will either (a) stuff more rooms into k4_wave, re-risking constant shadow, or (b) fork more megafiles. Spazer package already proved the correct multi-hop layout.

## Gold-standard reference
`routes/kpdr/spazer/`:
- geometry.py — named bands + predicates
- scripts.py — RLE tables
- helpers.py — play_script / lag break
- climb / approach / collect / drop / detour — one hop each
- __init__.py — public re-exports

## Target layout
```
routes/kpdr/wave/
  __init__.py              # re-export play_* + WAVE_BEAM_MASK
  geometry.py              # bands, seats, WAVE_BEAM_MASK, predicates
  scripts.py               # load or define RLE (prefer data/*.json — see sibling bead)
  bubble_to_single.py
  single_to_double.py
  double_to_wave.py
  helpers.py               # shared seat settle / one escape helper if not yet global
```
Keep `k4_wave.py` as a **thin re-export facade** (like k4_norfair) so registry / spine_hops / tests importing k4_wave or k4_norfair stay stable.

## Out of scope
- Route knob changes
- STATUS promote
- Implementing Ice
design:
1. Create package skeleton with empty modules + geometry constants moved first (no logic change).
2. Move Bubble→Single helpers + play_* with imports adjusted.
3. Move Single→Double.
4. Move Double→Wave (RLE may stay temporarily if RLE bead not done; do not re-inline).
5. k4_wave.py becomes `from super_metroid.routes.kpdr.wave import *` facade.
6. k4_norfair / registry / spine_hops keep working via existing import paths.
7. Run unit registration tests + dual pure Wave stack if sources exist.

Constant rule after split: geometry names are room-prefixed in geometry.py; never bare `_DOOR_X` at package import root for multi-hop constants.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] No routes/kpdr file for Wave multi-hop exceeds ~500 lines (package pieces)
- [ ] k4_wave.py is thin facade only (or deleted with imports updated)
- [ ] get_segment bubble_to_single / single_to_double / double_chamber_to_wave still resolve
- [ ] test_k4_norfair_scaffold + continuous tip hop ids still pass
- [ ] Dual pure Wave stack still GREEN if run (no intentional behavior change)
- [ ] No module-level constant can shadow another room's door X by import order
close_reason: Packaged k4_wave → routes/kpdr/wave/ (facade 30f); modules ≤403 lines; room-prefixed geometry; tests green

description:

ContinuousRunReport serializes transitions with:

transition.to_dict() if hasattr(transition, "to_dict") else asdict(transition)

Prefer always-typed path: ObservedTransition always implements to_dict (or report only accepts that type). Leave/entry kinematics stay read-only report data until pure contracts assert DoorKinematicsRequirement bands.

Small; do not block Pass A.

- [ ] Transitions still include leave/entry kinematics when present

title: Pass A: canonicalize human RLE (promote play_script, load data/*.json)
description:
## Severity
**P0 maintainability / dual source of truth.** Human gate-open sequence exists twice:

1. **Product (used):** inlined `_HUMAN_GATE_OPEN_RLE` tuple inside k4_wave.py (~45 RLE rows, tape f4650–5200)
2. **Data (unused by product):** `routes/kpdr/data/double_chamber_gate_open_rle.json`
3. **Also:** `dc_missile_wave_take04_paths.json` from parse_human_take — practice/docs, not product load

Spazer already has the right pattern buried in the wrong package:
- `routes/kpdr/spazer/scripts.py` — `RleScript` type + FLOOR_MID_RLE etc.
- `routes/kpdr/spazer/helpers.play_script` — only Spazer climb/approach/drop import it

Wave reimplemented the RLE frame loop with mid-hit abort/retry. Next tip (Ice/Moat/WJ) will paste more tuples into Python.

## Failure mode if unfixed
- JSON bitrots while Python is hand-edited (or reverse)
- Probe/practice tools and product controllers diverge
- Agents invent shot cadences because the load path is unclear (docs already say “do not invent shot cadences”)

## Required shape
1. Promote `RleScript` + `play_script` to a shared home:
   - Prefer `routes/controller_common.py` or new `routes/rle.py`
2. Wave double-chamber gate open **loads** `data/double_chamber_gate_open_rle.json` (normalize schema n/b vs tuple)
3. Delete inlined `_HUMAN_GATE_OPEN_RLE` from product code
4. Spazer can keep local scripts.py tables short-term but should import shared play_script (migrate Spazer tables later optional)
5. Reactive wrapper stays room-specific (Kamer seat, hit abort, floor recover, retry ≤3) **around** play_script — do not fork a second RLE player

## Related tools
- `scripts/tools/parse_human_take.py` — path JSON emitter; align RLE field schema with product loader
- `spazer/helpers.play_script` — canonical implementation to lift
design:
Loader sketch:
- `load_rle_json(path) -> RleScript` accepting list of {n, b} or [n, buttons]
- `play_script(session, runs, *, reason, room_id, stop_when=None, on_lag=...)`
- Wave `_dc_open_blue_gate` uses load once (module import or cached) then play_script with stop_when past_gate / room leave; outer retry loop unchanged

Tests:
- unit: load fixture JSON equals known tuple
- registration / pure dual Wave if available still green
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] play_script + RleScript live outside spazer/ (controller_common or routes/rle)
- [ ] Wave gate-open product path loads data/double_chamber_gate_open_rle.json
- [ ] No inlined _HUMAN_GATE_OPEN_RLE (or equivalent paste) in Python controllers
- [ ] Spazer uses shared play_script (not a private duplicate implementation)
- [ ] Dual pure double_chamber_to_wave still opens gate (no intentional cadence change)
close_reason: routes/rle.py play_script+load_rle_json; Wave gate loads data/*.json; Spazer re-exports shared player; test_rle green

title: Pass A: extract Ceres reactive policy from early_spine (659→1546)
description:
## Severity
**P0 structural.** early_spine.py grew 659→1546 lines. Roughly half is Ceres reactive room policy (arm-pump, magnet escape, elev climb) stuffed into the morph SpineHop / graph-edge composition module.

## Ownership collision (three layers in one file)
1. Open-loop seeds / ActionSpans (hash-pinned product timing)
2. Reactive Ceres controllers (`_ceres_reactive_elev_climb` ~240 lines of nested WRAM gates alone)
3. MORPH_SPINE table + MORPH_DOOR_EDGES + milestones + play_morph_hops

Layer 2 does not belong next to layer 3. Elev-ledge special cases will keep landing here (y=571 pose=2, ship pad, gs=8 remap) and the morph composition surface will become unreadable.

## Hot spots to extract
- `_ceres_arm_pump_*`, `_ceres_clear_knockback`, `_ceres_enemy_near`
- `_ceres_reactive_magnet_escape`, `_ceres_reactive_falling`
- `_ceres_reactive_elev_climb`, `_ceres_elev_top_to_ship`, ledge/ship band predicates
- play wrappers: `play_ceres_outbound_to_ridley`, `play_ceres_escape_to_landing` (keep names stable)
- Geometry constants: `_CERES_ELEV_*`, `_CERES_MAGNET_*`, `_CERES_KB_POSES`, etc.

Leave in early_spine.py:
- MORPH_SPINE / MORPH_DOOR_EDGES / MORPH_MILESTONES
- thin play_* that call into ceres package
- continuous_edges_from_morph_spine / validate_morph_spine
- landing→morph seed plays if still small

## Target layout
```
routes/kpdr/ceres/
  __init__.py
  arm_pump.py
  magnet.py
  elev_escape.py
  outbound.py      # or single ceres_escape.py if smaller is clearer
  geometry.py      # elev/magnet/ship bands
```

## Risk
Ceres is timing-sensitive (elevator lag, frame parity notes in AGENTS.md). Extraction must be pure move + re-export; no re-solve of ledge seats in this card.
design:
1. Create ceres package; move constants + pure helpers first.
2. Move reactive play functions; early_spine play_* become one-liners or re-exports.
3. Preserve public API of early_spine (__all__ + play_boot_to_ceres etc.) for continuous/early tips.
4. Smoke: morph continuous tip or pure Ceres-related tests if present; dual continuous --to morph if cheap.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] early_spine.py back under ~700 lines (spine + thin wrappers)
- [ ] ceres package owns reactive elev/magnet/arm-pump
- [ ] Public play_* names for morph continuous still importable from early_spine
- [ ] No intentional Ceres timing/knob change
- [ ] Relevant tests green

title: Pass A: one escape_kb helper + delete soft-budget pass dead code
description:
## Severity
P1 spaghetti / copy-paste debt. Easy behavior-preserving cleanup; do after or with Wave package split.

## Problem A — triple knockback wrappers in k4_wave
```
_escape_kb      → stop_room_id=ROOM_SINGLE_CHAMBER
_escape_kb_sc   → stop_room_id=ROOM_DOUBLE_CHAMBER
_escape_kb_dc   → stop_room_id=ROOM_WAVE
```
Only stop_room_id differs. Same call shape is also inlined repeatedly in to_speed.py, speed_return.py, k4_cathedral.py, moat.py (escape_knockback_spin with run_frames=6, spin_frames=18).

## Problem B — soft-budget pass is dead ceremony
```
if session.frame - start > _TOTAL_BUDGET:
    pass  # soft budget; room success is the gate
```
Present in all three Wave plays, speed_return, to_speed. Constants that never enforce anything are noise.

## Fix
1. Canonical thin helper (controller_common or skills/knockback):
   escape_kb(session, label, prefer, *, stop_room_id)
2. Room policies pass leave-room id; delete private clones.
3. Soft budgets: hard-fail with TimeoutError OR delete constants entirely (prefer delete if room success is the only gate).

## Couple with
Wave package (rr-7sn.1) so helpers land in wave/helpers or shared layer once, not thrice then moved.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] No _escape_kb / _escape_kb_sc / _escape_kb_dc private triples
- [ ] Shared helper used from Wave (and preferably speed/cathedral where trivial)
- [ ] No soft-budget pass dead branches; unused _TOTAL_BUDGET constants removed or enforced
- [ ] Tests/registration green; no intentional route change

title: Pass C: PROCESS room-policy layout + tip-extension prevention checklist
description:
## Severity
P1 prevention — without this, agents re-learn from Wave's bad shape on every tip.

## Add to docs/tasks/PROCESS.md (and optionally AGENTS.md one-liner pointer)

### Room policy layout
- Multi-hop tip (≥2 pure hops or human RLE) → package from day 1 (mirror spazer/)
- Geometry constants in geometry.py with **room-prefixed** names — never bare `_DOOR_X` in multi-hop modules
- Human tape → routes/kpdr/data/*.json via parse tool; product loads JSON; no inlined RLE tuples
- Use shared play_script / escape_knockback helpers / wait_ordinary_room / require_room — no private reimplementation
- File under ~500 lines or split before next knob; never grow past 1k without package split first

### Tip extension recipe (already true — restate as checklist)
1. pure controller (+ KPDR_SEGMENTS)
2. graph edges in progression/stages/
3. SpineHop + TipSegment CLI fields
4. run_to automatic via TipSpec — no per-tip runners

### Residual lifecycle (already true — restate)
One living residual per open tip segment; delete on promote/close.

## Why
Wave megafile + _DOOR_X shadow is the cautionary tale. Spazer package is the gold standard. Codify so Ice pure cannot land another 1.3k file.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] PROCESS.md has Room policy layout section with prevention checklist
- [ ] AGENTS.md or PROCESS links Spazer as gold-standard package layout
- [ ] Checklist items match Pass A/B beads (package, RLE data, no bare DOOR_X, residual lifecycle)

title: Pass B: second-pass consolidate green room policies (shared primitives)
description:
## Severity
P2 consolidation after Pass A. Behavior-preserving; delete concepts, not rename.

## Problem
Every pure hop invents the same shell:
require_room → unmorph/select → phase loops (knockback? band? hold) → wait_ordinary_room → TimeoutError dump

Fine at 3 rooms; toxic at Wave + Ice + Moat + second-pass of Cathedral/Speed/Spazer.

## Priority order (after Pass A lands)
1. Wave package internals — geometry/scripts/helpers; no duplicated phase loops across three plays
2. Spazer — drop private _compat aliases when unused; import shared play_script
3. to_speed + speed_return — share door-band + knockback patterns with Wave helpers
4. k4_cathedral — split if approaching ~800 before next tip
5. Prefer pure functions + shared primitives; **do not** invent a heavy RoomPolicy class hierarchy

## Out of scope
- New knobs / STATUS claims
- Ice pure implementation
design: Depends on Pass A: Wave package (rr-7sn.1), RLE canon (rr-7sn.2), escape_kb (rr-7sn.5) so consolidation reuses shared helpers rather than inventing a fourth copy.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Measurable LOC reduction or duplicate phase-loop deletion in at least Wave + one other arc
